## About this report

This joint report provides community leaders and public health partners with data-driven insights into shifting toxicological patterns and localized drug trends. The findings serve as a strategic blueprint to optimize outreach networks, guide public education, and deploy targeted overdose prevention programs across Orange County.
 

## Population focus

This report covers all fatalities within Orange County between January 1 and December 31, 2025, with a dedicated focus on drug overdose deaths.
